text:
ray_support: heads-up — customer reports promo apply from support console shows "Credit applied" toast but their ledger and billing page show no change. customer org org_42, invoice 1012. can someone triage? :confused:
opsbot: incident logged INC-2026-87 (auto).
eli_eng: ping — can you share the request id or exact time? i'll pull backoffice logs.
ray_support: req_id=rc-8f4b2e, user_id=u-9001, promo=TRIAL50, attempted at 2026-03-16T17:12:04Z. i also repro'd in staging: same toast, no ledger row.
jamie_platform: on the console we return success as soon as backoffice accepts the job (202). if the async worker fails after enqueue the UI will still show the toast. checking queue and worker logs next.
eli_eng: grabbed backoffice logs for rc-8f4b2e — see worker trace:
```
[2026-03-16T17:12:05Z] POST /apply-credit req=rc-8f4b2e -> 202 Accepted (job job_9345 enqueued)
[2026-03-16T17:12:06Z] worker(job_9345) START payload={org: org_42, user_token: t-temp-abc}
[2026-03-16T17:12:06Z] worker(job_9345) ERROR: ActiveRecord::NotNullViolation: null value in column "account_id" violates not-null constraint
  /srv/backoffice/app/services/ledger_writer.rb:82:in `insert'
  /srv/backoffice/app/workers/grant_worker.rb:27:in `perform'
[2026-03-16T17:12:06Z] worker(job_9345) ROLLBACK
```
eli_eng: looks like the worker attempted to write the ledger but account_id was nil and DB rolled back, so no ledger row. console saw enqueue success and showed toast.
sara_finance: confirmed — ran: SELECT * FROM ledger WHERE request_id='rc-8f4b2e'; returns 0 rows.
jamie_platform: hypothesis — admin console sometimes sends a temporary user token (t-temp-*) that isn't mapped to an account_id in the mapping service. we should validate mapping before enqueueing. current flow enqueues blindly.
eli_eng: agreed. immediate mitigations: 1) add pre-enqueue validation to backoffice /apply-credit to fetch canonical account_id and return 400 if missing; 2) add worker retry with alert on repeated NotNullViolation; 3) add an alert for job failures that touch ledger writes. i'll prepare a PR.
ray_support: for the affected customer — can we do a manual grant while fix is being rolled? they need trial credits today.
sara_finance: manual insert performed. credited 50 USD trial to org_42, ledger row created id=ledg_7782, notified customer.
jamie_platform: opened issue BACKOFFICE-2342 and pushed a staging hotfix to validate mapping. will deploy to prod after smoke tests. ETA ~2h.
eli_eng: PR #562 created with pre-enqueue check + unit tests. will add a small e2e in staging to ensure toast only shown on confirmed ledger write or queued-with-confirmation.
ray_support: thanks all — please add a short note to the support case about what to tell customers if they see the toast but no balance change (ask for req_id, and we'll check backoffice job status). :thumbsup:
opsbot: INC-2026-87 updated: BACKOFFICE-2342 linked.
jamie_platform: postmortem action items: (1) make console wait for enqueue+mapping confirmation, (2) instrument ledger write failures in Sentry and alert channel, (3) add a small DB invariant test for account_id presence.
eli_eng: will follow up with a short runbook for support to use when manual credit is required.
sara_finance: case updated and customer refunded trial credits manually. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
